data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'makhsus', meaning 'gifted', 'chosen', 'honored'. The name Makhzumi signifies one who is blessed with abundant gifts and generosity. The name Makhzumi carries the meaning “Gifted, generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Makhzumi usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
